en.title: Dispatch T-305: every project decides two-way or one-way, external ones included
en.explanation: Why: T-303 decides the change type only for this repository. How: each project gets its own approved list of sensitive paths, plus a shared base list.
en.before: An external task always takes the full path, and nobody decides its change type.
en.after: An external task takes the two-way or one-way path, and an unclear case waits on your card.
en.outcome: How: option A pins T-305, and its plan round starts now.

A.cons: Each external project needs one list card from you first.

B.cons: External tasks keep the full path.

C.cons: The change type stays a firstmate-only idea.

how.text: A card asks you to approve the list for each project, and a task with an unclear change type waits on a card.

questions.text: Do you approve the dispatch of T-305?

glossary.text: A door says if a revert can undo a change: a two-way door can and takes the short path, and a one-way door cannot.
A fail-first test fails on the old code and passes on the new code.
A gate is one automatic check that a pull request must pass before a merge card appears.
A pin is a frozen copy of an approved spec that a task uses until the captain approves a change.
A round is one worker run or one reviewer run on a task.
The scope is the list of file patterns that a task may change.

intent.text: Each project has its own approved sensitive list on top of a shared base list.
An external task follows its door in the steps firstmate owns.
A task whose door cannot be decided waits on a captain card.

why.text: The captain wants every project, not only this one, to have two paths.

done.text: Intent 1: a test shows a base-list path is one-way on every project.
Intent 2: a test shows an external two-way task builds first.
Intent 3: tests show each cannot-decide case raises a card.

notes.text: You approve the sensitive list of each project once.

door.reason: It changes pin records and the per-project config, which are on the sensitive list.
door.rollback: A revert alone does not undo the change, so the plan round states the rollback.

zh-TW.title: 派工 T-305：每個專案都能判定 two-way 或 one-way，含外部專案
zh-TW.explanation: 原因：T-303 只替這個 repo 判定改動類型。作法：每個專案有自己核准的敏感路徑清單，再加一份共用基本清單。
zh-TW.before: 外部任務一律走完整流程，沒有人判定改動類型。
zh-TW.after: 外部任務依類型分流程，判定不了就等你的卡。
zh-TW.outcome: 作法：選 A 會 pin T-305，計畫輪馬上開始。

A.pros: 外部的小改動能更快合併。
A.cons: 每個外部專案要先等你核准一張清單卡。

B.cons: 外部任務繼續走完整流程。

C.cons: 改動類型只用在 firstmate 自己。

how.text: 每個專案的清單由你在卡上核准；類型不明的任務等卡。

questions.text: 你同意派工 T-305 嗎？

glossary.text: 門說明改動是否容易復原：雙向門容易，走短流程；單向門難，走完整流程。
先失敗測試在舊程式上失敗，在新程式上通過。
關卡是合併卡出現前，PR 必須通過的一項自動檢查。
固定版本是已核准規格的凍結副本，任務用它直到船長核准修改。
輪次是工人或審查者在一個任務上的一次執行。
範圍是任務可以修改的檔案模式清單。

intent.text: 每個專案除了共用基本清單，還有自己核准過的敏感清單。
外部任務在 firstmate 自己管的步驟依 door 分流。
無法判定 door 的任務停下來，開卡問船長。

why.text: 船長要求所有專案都有兩條流程，不只本 repo。

done.text: 意圖 1：測試證明基本清單的路徑在每個專案都是 one-way。
意圖 2：測試證明外部 two-way 任務直接實作。
意圖 3：測試證明每種無法判定的情況都會開卡。

notes.text: 每個專案的敏感清單由你核准一次。

after_nodes.label: 依 door 分流或問船長

door.reason: It changes pin records and the per-project config, which are on the sensitive list.
door.rollback: 單靠還原無法撤銷改動，所以計畫輪寫明回復方式。
